description: Z-Image prompting best practices and rules

sentence_count.rationale: Each sentence should describe ONE aspect of the image

sentence_order: Subject description (who/what is in the image)
Lighting conditions (how the scene is lit)

human_subjects.description: Required elements when humans are present

elements.name: age_gender
elements.example: a young woman in her twenties

elements.name: skin_texture
elements.example: realistic skin texture, natural skin pores

elements.name: clothing_details
elements.example: wearing a navy blue silk blouse

elements.name: pose_action
elements.example: standing with arms at her sides

elements.name: lighting
elements.example: soft natural daylight from the left

elements.name: background
elements.example: blurred garden background with green foliage

content.description: Content that should never appear in prompts

high_effectiveness.name: structured_description
high_effectiveness.pattern: [Subject] with [hair description]. [Clothing with color, material, style]. [Pose/action]. [Environment]. [Lighting]. [Technical tags].
high_effectiveness.example: A young woman with long auburn hair in loose waves. She wears a navy blue silk blouse tucked into high-waisted cream linen trousers. Standing with arms relaxed at her sides, facing the camera. Outdoor garden setting with blurred green foliage background. Soft natural daylight from the left creating gentle shadows. Realistic skin texture, natural skin pores, photorealistic, ultra detailed.

high_effectiveness.name: layered_clothing
high_effectiveness.pattern: Describe clothing from outer to inner layer with materials
high_effectiveness.example: She wears a charcoal wool overcoat over a cream cashmere sweater, paired with dark denim jeans and brown leather boots.

high_effectiveness.name: specific_lighting
high_effectiveness.pattern: Describe light direction, quality, and effect
high_effectiveness.example: Warm golden hour sunlight from the right side creates long shadows and a soft glow on her skin.

low_effectiveness.name: keyword_spam
low_effectiveness.issue: No context, relationships unclear, AI may ignore many terms
low_effectiveness.example: beautiful, elegant, stunning, professional, high quality, detailed, perfect

low_effectiveness.name: single_run_on
low_effectiveness.pattern: One extremely long sentence with many clauses and descriptions all connected by commas and conjunctions...
low_effectiveness.issue: Hard to parse, priority unclear, may overwhelm model

low_effectiveness.name: vague_descriptions
low_effectiveness.example: A beautiful woman in nice clothes standing in a pretty place

low_effectiveness.name: philosophical_tangent
low_effectiveness.issue: Confuses model, adds noise, may cause hallucination
low_effectiveness.example: ...embodying the eternal cycle of nature's beauty and the fleeting nature of existence...

general: Start with the most important element (usually the subject)
Use specific numbers when relevant (e.g., 'mid-twenties' not just 'young')
Describe what you see, not what you interpret
Include at least one fabric/material term for each garment
Always specify the light direction (left, right, front, back, above)
human_subjects: Always include skin texture terms for realism
Describe hair color AND style separately
Mention accessories if visible (earrings, watch, etc.)
Specify pose even if simple ('standing relaxed', 'sitting upright')
Include expression cues if relevant ('neutral expression', 'slight smile')
clothing: Layer descriptions from visible outer to inner
Include both color AND material for each garment
Mention fit (fitted, loose, oversized) when relevant
Note patterns with specifics (small floral, wide stripes)
technical: Avoid stacking too many quality terms
Add 'realistic skin texture' for all human subjects
